Environmental social sciences Hydrology Water resources Correction to: Nature Water https://doi.org/10.1038/s44221-026-00710-0 , published online 14 September 2026. In the initially published version of the article, the implementation of two aspects of the multiverse analysis differed from their description in the Methods section: the 50% rolling windows were computed as contiguous half-width bins rather than overlapping windows; and the target-year interval for the year 2000 covered 2000–2010 rather than 1990–2010. Three duplicate estimates were also present in the dataset. The analysis has been re-run with the code matching the Methods section and the duplicates have been removed. Specific parts of the Results, Methods, Figs. 3–5 and the Supplementary Information have been amended accordingly. The main results of the paper are unchanged. For comparison, a list of text edits and the original figures are available as Supplementary Information accompanying this amendment. The changes have been made in the HTML and PDF versions of this article.
